correctness.rationale: A hypothetical odd-characteristic length-seven realization is forced to seven projectively distinct points whose recovery matchings make every pair lie in a unique selected triple; this is the Fano incidence structure, whose direct coordinate realization forces characteristic two. The known length-eight batch construction then gives equality.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The 2026 source paper leaves exactly this odd-characteristic k=3, t=4 one-column gap and lists exact t=4 values and alphabet dependence as open directions. Searches across all-symbol, DRGP, availability, and Fano terminology found no prior exact value; the classical Fano representability fact is explicitly not claimed as new.

value.rationale: The result closes the smallest unresolved odd-characteristic case in a recent code family and, combined with the known even-characteristic case, yields a complete dimension-three classification with a sharp characteristic dependence.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
